market_outlook.short_term: Bond volatility dominates with 30-year yield at 2004 highs and muni stress. Oil above $102 adds inflation pressure. US stocks stalled on Iran talks but AI/tech strength (Meta $2T, Akamai) provides support. Expect choppy, range-bound equities with elevated VIX. Fed rate hike bets rising create headwind for rate-sensitive sectors. 1-3 month outlook: cautious, volatility-driven.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle and defense spending provide structural growth tailwinds. However, sustained high yields (5%+ muni, 30-year at 2004 highs) will compress valuations and increase financing costs. Fiscal stress in US education/municipal sector signals potential future spending cuts. China trade truce (2-month extension) and Ukraine stalemate create geopolitical uncertainty. 6-12 month outlook: selective, favor quality and AI/defense over rate-sensitive and consumer-discretionary.
